name: 日付ごとにまとめた資料の操作履歴
prompt:
Refine LH15-0029 using the supplied images. Keep the current design; make only a scale and row-height correction.

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1 is attempt 1. Preserve its purple and plum avatar colors, exact Japanese strings, file/folder glyphs, white surface and overall order.
Image 2 is the exact compact 390 × 506 px Japanese target. It controls the correct text and avatar sizes and the row heights.
Image 3 controls the source purple/plum avatar identity and photo/folder glyph silhouettes.

CORRECT THE SCALE
Return a 390 × 506 px portrait screen or an image with the exact same 390:506 aspect ratio. At 390 px displayed width:
- user avatars must be 32 × 32 px, not larger
- nested shared-person avatar must also be 32 × 32 px
- author names should match image 2's compact Meiryo body size, about 14 px with 24 px line height
- action/time text should match image 2, about 12 px with 16 px line height
- the 「今日」 section and first record must use image 2's compact height; the first record is 96 px high and the first divider lies at y=144
- keep the second record 112 px high, third 76 px, 「先週」 band 32 px, and final record 100 px as in the current native composition.
Do not scale up the whole layout or enlarge the type to fill the canvas.

PRESERVE THE COPY AND COLORS
「今日」
「鈴木 まこと」
「名前を変更 · 12:23」
「礼拝準備の写真.jpg」
「1人と共有 · 12:23」
「佐藤 はるか」
「閲覧可能」
「閲覧 · 12:23」
「先週」
「フォルダーに追加 · 12:23」
「ライトハウス」
Keep main 「鈴」 avatars vivid purple with white glyphs, nested 「佐」 muted plum with a white glyph. Keep source photo-thumbnail and folder icon silhouettes. Retain the Japanese mock's white surfaces, pale neutral section headers, forest-green folder and gray photo-file treatment.

EXCLUDE
No additional records, no English labels, no device/app chrome, no footer, no new decorations. Preserve the exact order and empty space from image 2.
